bootstrap.method: percentile whole-lobby seed bootstrap, retaining eliminated empty clusters
percentile whole-lobby seed bootstrap, retaining eliminated empty clusters

pairing: Same eligible seed set across cap settings; shop comparisons are unpaired because purchases and pool use desynchronize draws.
population: Five-tribe lobbies conditioned on including Birds and Fairies; one committed seat per written line plus four blind Hard seats. Other three tribes follow the actual seeded game rotation. Not the unconditional shipped lobby population.

peat.attribution: Only successful pass3_bog:king triggers on peat_king bodies count as raises; only exact gold_next_turn carry operations immediately following pass3_bog:cutter triggers on peat_cutter bodies count as Cutter gold. Ability outputs on other bodies are separate. Original starting-side ownership is retained through Changeling swaps; King raises delivered to the opponent are reported separately. Native simultaneous-death Sink witnesses count, as in the source mechanics.
peat.denominator: One card-present seat-fight includes zero outputs and every native card body that started on board or entered during combat. Instances count distinct combat uid per fight; eligible instances had the native pass3 ability when observed. Golden and combat-copied bodies each count as one instance. Off-board hand, away and held cards count only if they enter. Starting-board presence is also retained.
peat.gold_stage: Cutter gold is actual credited next-turn gold after session carry, reconciled per fight against all gold carry plus separate early spoils. Target RecruitCarry adds gold without a carry cap. This does not measure later income, spending or whether an eliminated seat reaches its next turn.
peat.scope: All rounds, all real seats, including ghost-opponent fights; descriptive only.

starting_labels: All line grouping uses immutable starting line; final line is retained separately.
survival: Round summaries contain surviving seats only, with counts and R14 survival reported. No zero imputation. Whole-lobby seed bootstrap retains empty/eliminated clusters.
